about: Package BAL6 (K17): the cards a player holds arriving at each main map, for the Pool reference (ref-pool). Built by tools/opt/ref_pool.js pools; read by tools/opt/deckopt.js --mode ref-pool. No "id": tools/opt/ref_decks.js skips this file.

rule.rewards: each earlier main map's fights: nodeRewardCardIds + SKIRMISH_FIRST_PACK_CARDS / node.firstCard
rule.faction: faction_track_sim_2026_10_21.js simulate({side: "otters", seed: 7}), received before the map
rule.packs: 5 different Commons a cleared map from the basic packs open by then (PACK_TIER_FROM_MAP), mulberry(fnv("ref-pool|packs|map<m>"))
rule.copies: any card of the pool up to its rarity's copy cap
